queries.boundary: Rates describe the manufacturer's drug in trials; products sold outside trials are unknown.

competitors.gap: Gives phase 2 rates only, no phase 3 data and no same-trial comparison with semaglutide; references not tied to claims; site sits beside an order calculator.
Lists side effects qualitatively with no percentages.
Not checked in detail; aggregator without the 2026 REIMAGINE 2 six-arm safety data.
A single journal article; no cross-trial table of rates.

information_gain: The only page with the 2026 REIMAGINE 2 six-arm adverse-event table (cagrilintide alone 82.2% vs semaglutide 81.2% vs placebo 70.5%) beside the phase 2 dose-graded nausea rates and the REDEFINE 1 and 2 discontinuation figures, each with its own citation.
serp_format_rewarded: List of side effects with rates; AI Overview and People Also Ask; image pack.
